description: How much of a raw vegetable or fruit to buy for a recipe amount. Give the prepared amount in g, kg, oz or lb, or as a USDA household measure such as "cup chopped", "cup sliced", "medium" or "clove". Returns the edible weight needed, the as-purchased weight to buy at the USDA edible yield, and the number of whole items (for example medium onions) to buy.

food.description: Raw vegetable or fruit in plain words, for example "onion", "red bell pepper", "pineapple", "butternut squash", "broccoli", "avocado".

measure.description: g, kg, oz, lb, or a household measure such as "cup chopped", "cup sliced", "tbsp", "medium", "large", "clove". Default g.

name: calculate_amount_to_buy
title: Calculate how much produce to buy
